title: Convo Omnibox — quick-action sandbox (scratch PRD)
content:
TL;DR:
Small exploratory feature: an in-conversation omnibox (slash-command style) that lets power users apply lightweight transforms, route a message to alternate model profiles, run micro-evals, or send items to downstream tools (notes, ticket, search) without leaving the chat surface.

Problem we try to solve:
- Users often need to do quick transforms (summarize, redact, translate, extract action items) while staying in the conversation context.
- Switching to a separate tool or copy-pasting breaks flow and costs context.
- Platform customers want fine-grained control (e.g., route to cheaper model for mundane tasks) and observability for those actions.

Hypothesis:
If we provide an inline mini-command palette (omnibox) with a small, extensible set of transforms and routing actions, then power users will perform common operations 2-3x faster, reducing churn and token waste from copy/paste re-prompts.

MVP scope (what this scratch covers):
- UX: slash ('/') trigger in chat input that shows 6–10 actions + fuzzy search.
- Actions: summarize (short/long), redact PII, re-run with alternate model preset (economy/high-fidelity), convert to TODO (structured), send to Notes (customer's linked workspace).
- API: one-shot Omnibox action endpoint that accepts current convo id + selection + action + optional params. Returns transformed text and optional metadata (tokens used, model id).
- Metrics: click-through rate, time-to-complete action, token delta, conversion to downstream object (note/ticket).

User journeys / sample flows:
1) "Summarize and send to notes"
- User types /summarize 2 sent the last 5 turns to Summarize (short). Omnibox returns summary; user hits "Save to Notes" -> POST to integr.
- Acceptance: summary appears in Notes, omnibox returns model used and token count.

2) "Fallback to economy model"
- User composes long prompt, realizes cost is high -> /economy-run. Omnibox asks confirmation and runs the request with v-small model variant, returns response with provenance.
- Acceptance: response shown inline, UI tag indicates model used. Rollback flows if quality < threshold.

3) "Extract action items"
- /extract-actions applied to chunk -> returns JSON list of actions. UI offers quick convert to TODOs or push to ticketing.

API sketch (very rough):
POST /v1/omnibox/actions
body: { "convo_id": "c-0001", "selection": { "start": 523, "end": 842 } , "action": "summarize", "params": { "length": "short" } }
response: { "result_text": "...", "model": "gpt-like-8k-econ", "tokens": "120" }

Instrumentation / telemetry:
- Log omnibox_action events with fields: user_id, convo_id, action, params, start_time, end_time, tokens, model, success/failure, downstream_target (notes/ticket).
- Add trial A/B for top-level actions ordering and presence of routing options.

UX notes / microcopy:
- Keep omnibox non-modal; allow keyboard-only flow.
- Show estimated token delta and cost change inline before execute (if routing to different model).
- Provide small inline badge showing "routed to: economy" or "provenance: summarize-v1" on result.

Security / compliance considerations:
- Redaction action must run in an approved private model in Private deployments (can't ship PII to hosted models).
- Allow org-level policy to disable certain actions (e.g., external share).

Rollout plan (phases):
- Phase 0: internal alpha — console + web only, subset of actions (summarize, extract-actions, economy-run).
- Phase 1: beta + telemetry + opt-in in org settings. Add integrations (Notes).
- Phase 2: feature flags for Dedicated/Private differences (KMS, on-prem redaction).

Open questions / parking lot:
- How to express model routing policy? (explicit selection vs policy-driven suggestions).
- Should omnibox actions create new messages or mutate existing message? (mutable vs append).
- UX for long-running actions (evals) — spinner vs async notification.
- What granularity of audit logs for compliance? (per-token or per-action).
- Plug-in extensibility model: can customers register custom omnibox actions that call webhooks? Security model?

Next steps / TODOs (me):
- Wireframe the omnibox in Figma (placeholder screens) — assign to Asha.
- Spike backend API for economy-run with a dev flag.
- Draft Linear ticket with event schema + sample BigQuery table mapping.
- Sync with SRE about cost guardrails for economy-run bulk usage.

Notes to self:
- Keep the initial action set small, prioritize those that reduce duplication and token churn.
- Think about an "omnibox history" for quick re-use.
- Could be a good cross-sell with Redwood Console: show top omnibox actions and per-route costs in the Console insights.

Related refs / links (rough):
- Linear: CORE-1428 (omnibox spike)
- Slack: #console-product thread "omnibox idea" (Feb 7)
- GH: /redwood-inference/console PR:312 (proto omnibox keyboard hook)

Parking lot ideas (do later):
- Omnibox macros (multi-step pipelines).
- Team-shared action presets.
- In-omnibox code execution for small transforms (e.g., regex extract).
